title: WPSS/2102/2018 of Geeta Dalakoti Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
WPSS No. 990 of 2019
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.

Ms. Joyshna Pant, Advocate, holding
brief of Mr. A.K. Joshi, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. S.K. Mishra, Standing Counsel for
the State of Uttarakhand.
Issue notice to the respondent no. 5 by
registered post, acknowledgment due,
returnable at an early date.
Steps to be taken within a week.
As prayed, four weeksí time is granted
to learned counsel for the respondent to file
counter affidavit.
List this matter after four weeks
alongwith WPSS No. 2102 of 2018, 2103 of
2018, 2107 of 2018 & 2108 of 2018.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
NEHA 02.05.2019
